introduction: NOCTURNO DE CHILE is composed of two videos: LA CACERIA (THE HUNT) and LA CENA (THE DINNER). Both videos are adaptations of Roberto Bolaño’s novel by the same title. The videos are meant to be viewed side by side, each video representing an adjacent room. In one room we find a dinner of intellectuals and writers; and in the neighboring room a torture is taking place.Duration 3:22 min“Nocturno de Chile” was exhibited in the MAVI (Museo de artes visuales) in Santiago, Chile as part of the video art exhibition “Maquina Blanda” from December 2007 – January 2008.from:http://leoncocina.com/nocturno-de-chile/
